results: All 500 Borg task-event shards and BPI archive acquired with checksums.

Classical copula pilot improves joint count CRPS with fixed marginals. Borg selects job correlation; BPI selects global correlation only. These are exploratory, sampled-population results, not final method evidence.
17 local replay, score, and dependence-model tests passed; third-party suites are separate and were not claimed as validated.

Borg history-v1 three-seed Gaussian/common-shock full cohort evaluations completed; selected-v2 awaits final neural control fits.
